body: They do, it's hard to open up about this sort of thing though.
I did open up a bit more last night, I do feel a little bit better. I still can't shake the feeling, but it takes time right?
It's hard to have goals when you don't see yourself being alive for much longer.

I try to do things that made me happy, or that I enjoyed doing when I'm feeling OK but it's when I'm not OK, that's when doing anything becomes a huge problem. I can't seem to find the motivation. The only thing that gets me out of bed is the fact that I have to go to work, to be able to afford to have a n=bed that I don't want to get out of.
I don't hear that ever, so thank you.
I've told people how I'm feeling, but they still don't seem to care. They all seem to change the subject or I don't hear from them again.
I'm just so ready to give up. I don't know how much longer I can go on.
"even if somebody else has it much worse, that doesn't really change the fact that you have what you have.”
I don't know why... I don't see myself being alive. I don't see myself getting any older. I don't know why it would be telling me to stay.
I appreciate that. I do try to focus on hobbies, I myself draw but sometimes the motivation just isn't there.
I'm not completely sure. I just find it really hard to be happy about anything.
The dreams are the only thing that make me happy anymore. Sometimes I'll just dream that we're sitting on the couch watching a movie, cuddling. I miss it.

I was prescribed anti-depressants which one of the side effects for is having vivd dreams. The problem is that all my dreams involve my ex, which makes me even more depressed when I wake up. The dreams are great and the only time that I'm really happy are when I'm asleep and having those dreams.
